name: City Together
hook: Build a little town together. Watch it grow.
how: Lay roads, then zone homes, shops and parks next to them. Homes fill with people, shops bring jobs, and taxes pay for more. Grow from a hamlet to a city, and the town is still there the next time anyone comes back.
controls: Pick a tool and click or drag on the map to build; drag with the hand (or right mouse) to move, wheel or pinch to zoom, Q/E to turn
uses: The town is remembered by the players who built it: whoever comes back first brings it back for everyone.
The host's browser checks every build, grows the town and keeps the shared money; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
AI mayors lay streets and zone lots until enough people join.
The biggest town each player has helped build.
Speed up growth or raise taxes for an event without touching the code.
ideas: Add a day and night cycle with street lights
Add factories that make jobs but scare away homes
Add a mayor's goal each week with a reward
